p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

en: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

en:
113:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
113:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה‎ Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

en: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
u.src: 2  Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

p.src: 3  From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

en: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.
u.src: 3  From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

p.src: 4  The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

en: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
u.src: 4  The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

p.src: 5  Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

en: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,
u.src: 5  Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

p.src: 6  who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

en: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
u.src: 6  who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

p.src: 7  He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

en: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
u.src: 7  He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

p.src: 8  that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

en: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
u.src: 8  that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

p.src: 9  He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

en: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 9  He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
